keyEvents.text: Matteo Palma (Udinese) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bologna 1, Udinese 0. Nadir Zortea (Bologna) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jens Odgaard.
Substitution, Bologna. Rahim Alhassane replaces Riccardo Orsolini.
Oumar Solet (Udinese) is shown the yellow card.
Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Udinese. Alessandro Zanoli replaces Matteo Palma.
Substitution, Udinese. Vakoun Bayo replaces Sandi Lovric.
Goal! Bologna 1, Udinese 1. Nicolò Zaniolo (Udinese) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner.
Substitution, Udinese. Mërgim Vojvoda replaces Nicolò Zaniolo.
Substitution, Bologna. Samuel Mbangula replaces Federico Bernardeschi.
Substitution, Bologna. Martin Vitík replaces Nadir Zortea.
Substitution, Bologna. Mikel Amondarain replaces Matteo Darmian.
Substitution, Bologna. Roberto Piccoli replaces Nicolò Cambiaghi.
Substitution, Udinese. Oier Zarraga replaces Jakub Piotrowski.
Substitution, Udinese. David Alaba replaces Christian Kabasele.
